- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Siemens aims to be carbon-neutral by 2030, improve energy efficiency of products by 3% per year, increase recycled materials in products to 75% by 2030, help cities reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 10 Gigatons CO2 by 2030, increase women in leadership positions to 25% by 2025, and reach 6 million people with educational programs by 2025.
